units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 14:19">Targ. Is. XIV, 19</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00281"><he>יְחַט</he></cite>; a. fr., v. <cite ref="K00002"><he>כְּ־</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 28b:10">M. Kat. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מותא כי מותא וכ׳</he> death like death, i.e. death must naturally ensue, v. <cite ref="H00028"><he>חֲבוּלְיָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:15">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>יומא כי האידנא</he> on a day like this.—<he>כי הא ד־</he> as that which is told of &c.
<cite ref="Chagigah 2a:6">Ḥag. 2ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>דלא כי האי תנא</he> which is not in agreement with the opinion of &c.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 46a:11">B. Kam. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>לְכִי הא דאיתמר</he> for a case like the one that is told.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 49a:4">Ned. 49ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כי אתריה</he>, v. <cite ref="A03444"><he>אֲתַר</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Horayot 13b:13">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>נתקין … כי לדידן</he> let us institute something like that which has been done concerning ourselves; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Leviticus 26:44">Targ. Y. II, Lev. XXVI, 44</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 110a:2">Ḥull. 110ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 87a:10">B. Bath. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>כי סליק וכ׳</he> when R. El. went to Palestine.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 74a:21">Snh. 74ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כי אתא וכ׳</he> when R. … came (from Palestine).—<he>וכי תימא</he> (abbr. <he>וכ״ת</he>), v. <cite ref="A01965"><he>אֲמָא</he> II</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:13:4">Y. Snh. VII, end, 25ᵈ</cite> <he>כי יתבון וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="K00518"><he>כיי</he></cite>) when they sat down to eat; a. v. fr.—<he>כי היכי</he>

senses.gloss: as well as, in the same way as.
